The test image shows mature/dead soybean stems with:
- Bleached white/gray stem surface (late season, dry dead stems)
- Small black flask-shaped pycnidia arranged in parallel rows along the stem
- Dark discoloration at nodes

The bottom-right panel of the Diaporthe reference collage matches perfectly — showing the same bleached white stem with parallel rows of small black pycnidia. This is the hallmark diagnostic sign of Diaporthe (pod and stem blight).
